title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium): customer-managed keys for review set data at rest
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap targets, licensing statements and Customer Key onboarding command are supported. It accurately reports Microsoft's conflicting statements about review set coverage and leaves review-set-specific policy selection and rollout behaviour unresolved.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans customer-managed encryption key options for data at rest in eDiscovery (Premium) review sets.
claims.quote: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data stored in eDiscovery review sets

claims.claim: The roadmap is the only located source describing this planned feature, rather than existing related Customer Key behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: "eDiscovery" "review set" "Customer Key"; read roadmap and all cited Learn pages; Learn states existing review set coverage and direct-export preview behaviour but does not identify this planned roadmap capability.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Scope; controls[0].governs
claims.claim: Learn's review set page says review set content at rest is encrypted with the customer-managed key if the tenant is configured with Customer Key.
claims.quote: Does Customer Key apply to review set content? | Yes. If your tenant is configured with Customer Key, review set content at rest is encrypted with the customer-managed key.

claims.claim: The direct-export page says data at rest in an eDiscovery review set is not included at this time.
claims.quote: This encryption applies to direct exports only. Data at rest in an eDiscovery review set isn't included at this time.

claims.claim: The Microsoft review set and direct-export pages give conflicting statements about review set Customer Key coverage.
claims.quote: Direct exports: "Data at rest in an eDiscovery review set isn't included at this time." Review set page: "review set content at rest is encrypted with the customer-managed key."

claims.claim: Learn already describes review set Customer Key coverage while the roadmap still lists the planned feature as In development.
claims.quote: Yes. If your tenant is configured with Customer Key, review set content at rest is encrypted with the customer-managed key.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Review set content is stored in Microsoft-managed Azure Storage.
claims.quote: When you add content to a review set, the items and their metadata are copied to a Microsoft-managed Azure Storage location dedicated to the case.

claims.claim: The Azure Storage holding review set content is Microsoft-owned.
claims.quote: Yes. The storage is Microsoft-owned and Microsoft-managed.

claims.claim: Review set storage is provisioned per case, not per review set.
claims.quote: No. Storage is provisioned per case. Multiple review sets within the same case share the underlying case storage

claims.claim: Review set storage is provisioned in the region matching the case's geo.
claims.quote: The storage is provisioned in the region that matches the case's geo, consistent with Microsoft 365 data residency commitments.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Adding content to a review set copies items from their original data sources in the live services into Azure Storage.
claims.quote: All items in the search results are copied from the original data source in the live services to a secure Azure Storage location in the Microsoft cloud.

claims.claim: Review sets can hold copies of mailbox content collected for investigations.
claims.quote: Adding data to a review set is a long-running process that includes gathering items from the original data sources in Microsoft 365 (for example, from mailboxes and sites), copying them to the Azure Storage location

claims.claim: Review sets can hold copies of SharePoint content.
claims.quote: In the What to include for files from ODSP sites? section, complete the following options: Select document versions: Specify how many versions of SharePoint documents to collect.

claims.claim: Review sets can hold collected Teams content.
claims.quote: Include Teams and Viva Engage conversations: Collect up to 12 hours of related conversations when a message matches a search.

claims.claim: Customer Key adds a layer of encryption using the customer's own keys.
claims.quote: With Customer Key, you add a layer of encryption using your own keys.

claims.claim: Customer Key encrypts only data at rest in the cloud.
claims.quote: Customer Key encrypts only data at rest in the cloud. It doesn’t protect on-premises mailboxes or files.

claims.claim: Customers explicitly authorise Microsoft 365 to use their encryption keys.
claims.quote: You explicitly authorize Microsoft 365 to use your encryption keys to deliver value-added services like eDiscovery, anti-malware, anti-spam, and search indexing.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Customer Key supports customer-managed keys held in Azure Key Vault or Azure Key Vault Managed HSM.
claims.quote: Azure Key Vault and Azure Key Vault Managed HSM integrate with Azure services and Microsoft 365 for customer-managed keys. You can use your own keys in Azure Key Vault and Azure Key Vault Managed HSM for encryption at rest of data stored in these services.

claims.claim: The Customer Key setup page requires Key Vault Administrators for Azure Key Vault configurations.
claims.quote: Customer Key requires both Key Vault Administrators (for daily key management tasks) and Key Vault Contributors (for permission and role assignment).

claims.claim: The Customer Key setup page requires Key Vault Contributors for Azure Key Vault configurations.
claims.quote: Customer Key requires both Key Vault Administrators (for daily key management tasks) and Key Vault Contributors (for permission and role assignment).

claims.claim: The described feature concerns stored review set encryption and describes no autonomous behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: "eDiscovery" "review set" "Customer Key"; read roadmap, review set, Customer Key overview/setup and direct-export pages; no autonomous actions attributed to the review set CMK feature.
